subject: dancer
full_caption:
This dancer spins LEFT for some people and RIGHT for others 🌀

It's a flat silhouette with zero depth cues, so your brain has to guess which side is in front — and it can guess either way. Watch the outlines flip it, then try switching it with your mind.

Which way did you see FIRST? Comment ⬅️ or ➡️
Send this to a friend and see if they see it the same way 👀

#opticalillusion #illusion #perception #visualillusion #opticpop
